# Hayven

> Hayven is a B2C AI career coaching and salary negotiation platform. It helps professionals understand their market value, negotiate job offers and raises, build stronger resumes, and make better career decisions.

Hayven offers free and paid tools for salary benchmarking, offer evaluation, counter-offer scripting, negotiation practice, resume analysis, and career coaching via an AI assistant named Sarah.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://gethayven.com): Overview of all tools and features
- [AI Career Coach](https://gethayven.com/ai-career-coach): Personalized career coaching powered by AI
- [Compensation Analyzer](https://gethayven.com/compensation-analyzer): See your p25–p90 salary range by role, level, and city
- [Offer Evaluator](https://gethayven.com/offer-evaluator): Score any job offer 0–100 across salary, equity, and benefits
- [Counter-Offer Builder](https://gethayven.com/counter-offer-builder): Build a data-backed counter-offer with email and call scripts
- [Negotiation Simulator](https://gethayven.com/negotiation-simulator): Practice salary negotiation against an AI recruiter
- [Objection Handler](https://gethayven.com/objection-handler): Scripts for every recruiter pushback
- [Negotiation Playbook](https://gethayven.com/negotiation-playbook): Step-by-step negotiation strategy for your exact offer
- [Interview Salary Coach](https://gethayven.com/interview-salary-coach): What to say when asked salary expectations in an interview
- [Raise Request Builder](https://gethayven.com/raise-request-builder): Build a raise request with market data and talking points
- [Equity Calculator](https://gethayven.com/equity-calculator): Calculate what your stock options and RSUs are actually worth
- [Raise Calculator](https://gethayven.com/raise-calculator): Calculate your new salary after a raise
- [Salary to Hourly Calculator](https://gethayven.com/salary-to-hourly-calculator): Convert annual salary to hourly rate
- [Paycheck Calculator](https://gethayven.com/paycheck-calculator): Calculate take-home pay after taxes
- [Resume Builder](https://gethayven.com/resume-builder): AI resume scoring, ATS analysis, and bullet rewrites
- [Resume Templates](https://gethayven.com/resume-templates): ATS-friendly resume templates with AI feedback
- [Job Tracker](https://gethayven.com/job-tracker): Track job applications and follow-ups
- [Salary Guides](https://gethayven.com/tools/salaries): Role-specific salary ranges, top-paying cities, and negotiation tips

## Blog

Hayven publishes practical salary negotiation and career guides at https://gethayven.com/blog.

## About

Hayven is free to start. Pro plans are available at $20/month. The platform does not provide legal or financial advice.
